1. Ecosystem Scope & Guardian Eligibility

JUNEAR provides a protected Android Bento Launcher, native Device Owner MDM enforcement, E.164 call screening for children aged 6–14, and role-isolated Progressive Web Applications for Co-Parents, Extended Family, and Classroom Teachers.

Family accounts may only be created by adults aged 18 or older holding lawful parental responsibility under GDPR Article 8.

2. Subscription Plans (planType), Billing & 14-Day EU Withdrawal Right

JUNEAR supports six canonical entitlement states stored on families/{familyId}.planType:

planType KeyPlan NameEntitlement Scope & Billing Model
trialFree Family TrialFull-featured evaluation period with zero automatic charge traps.
monthlyMonthly Family PlanFlexible month-to-month access for Co-Parents, child profiles, and Grandparent Photo Wall.
yearlyAnnual Family PlanDiscounted yearly entitlement covering all multi-adult roles and classroom linking.
lifetimeOne-Time Lifetime LicenseSingle purchase unlocking full family features across the entire 6–14 age lifecycle.
vip_freeOperator VIP EntitlementDirect operator-granted complimentary family license without payment token requirements.
school_pilotClassroom / School PilotInstitutional pilot license enabling full classroom and family coordination for partner schools.

EU Consumer Right of Withdrawal: Under EU Directive 2011/83/EU, consumers may withdraw from a digital subscription purchase within 14 days without giving any reason by contacting info@gabba.bond (or directly via Google Play Subscriptions for Play Billing purchases).

3. Responsibilities of Co-Parents, Extended Family & Classroom Teachers

  • Co-Parents (coParentUids): Responsible for curating the E.164 phone whitelist, reviewing Double-Parent Handshake peer requests, toggling Vacation/Sick-Day overrides when appropriate, and keeping the Offline Master Unlock secret accessible to guardians.
  • Extended Family (familyMemberUids): May join strictly by Co-Parent invitation for read-only Family Photo Wall viewing and approved family calling.
  • Classroom Teachers (teacherUids): Must use classCode links exclusively for legitimate classroom instruction within allowedSchoolWindow, respecting Co-Parent Vacation/Sick-Day overrides and global app blacklists.

4. Native Android Enterprise MDM Scope & Three Provisioning Tiers

JUNEAR never uses Android AccessibilityService to simulate taps or read screen contents. All kiosk and app-visibility rules use official Android Enterprise DevicePolicyManager APIs via JunearDeviceAdminReceiver.

Guardians may choose (A) Play Store Standard mode, (B) 6-Tap Factory-Reset QR Device Owner enrollment, or (C) Zero-Reset Browser WebUSB provisioning (/junear/usb-setup).

5. Mandatory Dual Anti-Brick Escape Hatch Guarantee

As a non-negotiable child-safety invariant, JUNEAR guarantees that a family’s phone can never be locked out due to server downtime, lost connectivity, or expired subscriptions:

  • Path 1 — 1-Click Remote Firestore Release (REMOTE_RELEASE): Any Co-Parent can dispatch REMOTE_RELEASE from the Parent PWA to clear all UserManager restrictions, un-hide apps, exit LockTask, and execute clearDeviceOwnerApp().
  • Path 2 — 100% Offline 8-Digit HMAC-SHA256 Master Unlock Code: Tapping the Kiosk Shield 5 times opens a built-in numeric keypad accepting the deterministic 8-digit daily HMAC code — working with zero Wi-Fi, zero mobile data, and zero SIM card.

6. Limitation of Liability & Governing Law

JUNEAR is a supportive digital safety platform and does not replace active parental supervision or public emergency services. Emergency short codes (112, 104, 105, 107, 144) are preserved unconditionally across all modes.

These Terms are governed by the laws of Hungary and the European Union, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection rights in your EU country of residence.
